info.name: PINAK — Super-App API Collection
info.description:
# PINAK Super-App Master API Collection

Welcome to the official API specification and Postman workspace for the **PINAK Discount, Loyalty & Merchant Super-App**.

---

## 🌐 Environments & Base URLs

| Environment | Base URL | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Local Development** | `http://localhost:8080` | Local Spring Boot backend running on developer workstation. |
| **Staging / Docker** | `http://localhost:8081` | Containerized staging environment with managed PostgreSQL. |
| **Production** | `https://pinak-server.onrender.com` | Live cloud deployment. |

---

## 📱 Mobile Architecture & Security Design

1. **Passwordless Phone-First Authentication**: Customers register and log in solely using their mobile phone number. No passwords are stored or required for end consumers.
2. **Database-Driven OTP Ledger (`mobile_otps`)**: All OTP challenges are generated as cryptographically secure 6-digit codes and persisted in PostgreSQL `mobile_otps`. Mock OTP bypasses are strictly disabled in production-grade flows.
3. **Anti-Spam & Cooldown Rate Limits**: Strict 60-second cooldown per phone number enforced directly in the database (`cooldown_until`). Duplicate requests within 60s return `429 Too Many Requests`.
4. **Anti-Brute-Force Lockout**: The database tracks verification `attempts`. If an incorrect code is entered 5 times (`MAX_OTP_ATTEMPTS = 5`), the challenge is marked consumed and invalidated, returning `401 Unauthorized`.
5. **Timing-Safe Cryptographic Byte Comparison**: OTP codes are verified using constant-time byte comparison (`MessageDigest.isEqual`) to eliminate timing-attack vulnerabilities.
6. **Smart Gateway Routing (Dual-Token Architecture)**:
   - **Returning Members** (`isNewUser: false`): Immediately issued customer Bearer JWT `token` + `refreshToken`, routed to `HOME_DASHBOARD`.
   - **New Signups** (`isNewUser: true`): Issued a restricted `onboardingToken`, routed to `PROFILE_SETUP_SCREEN_08` to complete mandatory details and claim the ₹100 welcome reward coupon.

---

## 🗄️ PostgreSQL Database Inspection
To inspect the generated OTPs directly in PostgreSQL:
```sql
-- View latest mobile OTP challenges
SELECT id, phone, otp_code, session_id, channel, expires_at, cooldown_until, attempts, is_consumed, is_verified, created_at
FROM mobile_otps
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

---

## 🚦 Standard ApiResponse Envelope
Every endpoint uniformly wraps responses in this envelope:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Human-readable success description",
  "data": { ... },
  "requestId": "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"
}
```
Error envelope:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Error description",
  "errorCode": "VALIDATION_FAILED | INVALID_CREDENTIALS | RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "details": null
  },
  "requestId": "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"
}
```

item.name: 📱 Mobile Application
item.description:
# 📱 Mobile Application Subsystem (Screens 05–15)

This high-level directory contains all consumer-facing APIs for the **PINAK Mobile Super-App**, spanning the complete customer lifecycle from onboarding to in-store checkout and loyalty redemption.

---

### 🗺️ Screen & Feature Map

| Phase | Screen IDs | Name & Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Phase 1: Auth & Onboarding** | **Screens 05–08** | **Mobile Auth**: Passwordless 6-digit OTP verification, E.164 phone normalization, SIM binding status, smart gateway router, and compulsory Profile Setup (Name, City, Zone, Birthday, Referral Code, ₹100 Welcome Bonus). |
| **Phase 2: Discovery & Loyalty** | **Screens 09–11** | **Home & Radar Discovery**: Location/Push permissions consent, dynamic personalized Home Feed, Daily Login Streak Rewards, and Radar Merchant Geofencing. |
| **Phase 3: Merchant & Checkout** | **Screens 12–14** | **Store & QR Pay**: Store profile & menu, interactive Bill Discount Calculator, Soundbox-integrated QR Scan & Pay, and instant digital payment receipts. |
| **Phase 4: Rewards Vault** | **Screen 15** | **Rewards Vault**: Mystery Scratch Cards, merchant discount vouchers, and referral reward earnings. |

---

### 🔒 Security Principles for Mobile
- **Zero Hardcoded/Mock OTPs**: All verification challenges are backed exclusively by PostgreSQL `mobile_otps` table.
- **Dual Token Scopes**: Strict separation between guest `onboardingToken` and customer `accessToken`.
- **Rate Limiting**: Cooldown enforcement per phone number (`429 Too Many Requests`).

item.name: 🔐 Mobile Authentication & Onboarding
item.description:
# 🔐 Mobile Authentication & Onboarding Module

Implements the end-to-end passwordless mobile login and customer onboarding pipeline for Screens 05, 07, and 08.

---

### 🔄 Complete Lifecycle Sequence

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor App as PINAK Mobile App
    participant API as MobileAuthController
    participant Service as MobileAuthServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (mobile_otps & users)
    participant SMS as SMS/WhatsApp Gateway

    App->>API: POST /api/v1/mobile/auth/send-otp { phone: "9876543210", channel: "SMS" }
    API->>Service: sendOtp(request)
    Service->>DB: Check cooldown (cooldown_until > NOW())
    alt Cooldown Active (< 60s)
        Service-->>App: 429 Too Many Requests (Please wait 60s)
    else Cooldown Cleared
        Service->>DB: Invalidate previous unconsumed OTPs for phone
        Service->>Service: Generate secure 6-digit OTP & session ID
        Service->>DB: INSERT INTO mobile_otps (phone, otp_code, session_id, expires_at, cooldown_until)
        Service->>SMS: Deliver OTP via SMS/WhatsApp gateway (logged in dev)
        Service-->>App: 200 OK { sessionId, phone, channel, resendAvailableInSeconds: 60 }
    end

    Note over App,DB: Customer inputs 6-digit OTP code from SMS or PostgreSQL

    App->>API: POST /api/v1/mobile/auth/verify-otp { phone, otp, sessionId }
    API->>Service: verifyOtp(request)
    Service->>DB: Query unconsumed OTP from mobile_otps
    alt Wrong OTP Code entered
        Service->>DB: UPDATE mobile_otps SET attempts = attempts + 1
        Service-->>App: 401 Unauthorized (Invalid OTP code)
    else 5 Failed Attempts Exceeded
        Service->>DB: UPDATE mobile_otps SET is_consumed = TRUE
        Service-->>App: 401 Unauthorized (Too many failed attempts. Locked out.)
    else OTP Valid & Not Expired
        Service->>DB: UPDATE mobile_otps SET is_verified = TRUE, is_consumed = TRUE
        alt New Member (Profile Incomplete)
            Service-->>App: 200 OK { isNewUser: true, onboardingToken, nextScreen: "PROFILE_SETUP_SCREEN_08" }
        else Returning Member (Profile Completed)
            Service-->>App: 200 OK { isNewUser: false, token, refreshToken, nextScreen: "HOME_DASHBOARD" }
        end
    end
```

---

### 🧪 How to Test with PostgreSQL OTP Ledger
1. Run **`01. Send Mobile OTP`** with your test phone number.
2. In PostgreSQL, run:
   ```sql
   SELECT phone, otp_code, session_id, expires_at, is_consumed 
   FROM mobile_otps 
   WHERE is_consumed = false 
   ORDER BY created_at DESC 
   LIMIT 1;
   ```
3. Copy the 6-digit `otp_code` into the Postman collection variable `{{otpCode}}` (or edit the `verify-otp` body directly).
4. Run **`03. Verify OTP & Smart Gateway`**.

request.description:
### Send 6-Digit Mobile OTP (Screen 05)

Initiates customer authentication by triggering a 6-digit OTP challenge. Normalizes the mobile number into standard E.164 (`+91XXXXXXXXXX`), applies anti-spam rate limiting, invalidates any previously issued unconsumed codes, and inserts a fresh challenge row into PostgreSQL `mobile_otps`.

---

### 📥 Request Body Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `phone` | `string` | **Yes** | 10-digit Indian phone (`9876543210`) or E.164 (`+919876543210`). Must start with 6, 7, 8, or 9. | `"9876543210"` |
| `channel` | `string` | No | Delivery method: `"SMS"` (default) or `"WHATSAPP"`. | `"SMS"` |
| `whatsappAlertsEnabled` | `boolean` | No | User opt-in checkbox for promotional and order updates via WhatsApp. | `true` |
| `soundboxStaySignedIn` | `boolean` | No | Merchant POS flag for keeping soundbox credentials pinned. | `false` |
| `referralCode` | `string` | No | Referral code entered by consumer (e.g. `"FRIEND100"`). Previews ₹100 reward. | `"FRIEND100"` |

---

### 🛡️ Business & Security Rules
1. **Database Ledger (`mobile_otps`)**: Generates a cryptographically random 6-digit code via `SecureRandom` and records it directly in PostgreSQL with `expires_at = NOW() + 5 minutes` and `cooldown_until = NOW() + 60 seconds`.
2. **Cooldown Enforcement**: Rejects duplicate calls within 60 seconds with `429 Too Many Requests`.
3. **Sanitization**: Rejects non-Indian phone formats, non-numeric characters, and invalid telecom circles.
4. **Database State Clean-up**: Automatically marks all previous unconsumed OTP rows for this phone as consumed (`is_consumed = TRUE`).

### Resend Mobile OTP (Screen 07)

Dispatches a new OTP challenge once the 60-second cooldown timer expires.

---

### 🛡️ Enforcement & Lifecycle
- **If called within 60 seconds**: The PostgreSQL database check halts the request and returns `429 Too Many Requests`.
- **If called after 60 seconds**: Marks previous OTPs as consumed, inserts a new OTP challenge in `mobile_otps`, issues a new `sessionId`, resets the 60-second cooldown, and dispatches the new code.

request.description:
### Smart OTP Verification & Gateway Router (Screen 07)

Verifies the customer's 6-digit OTP code against the active record in the PostgreSQL `mobile_otps` table.

---

### 📥 Request Body Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `phone` | `string` | **Yes** | Phone number normalized to E.164. | `"9876543210"` |
| `otp` | `string` | **Yes** | 6-digit OTP code stored in `mobile_otps`. | `"721904"` |
| `sessionId` | `string` | No | Optional challenge session ID for audit tracing. | `"otp_sess_a81d4e2b09c1"` |

---

### 🛡️ Five-Stage Security Check
1. **Database Match**: Queries `mobile_otps` where `phone = ? AND is_consumed = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`.
2. **Expiry Verification**: Rejects if `expires_at < NOW()` (5-minute TTL).
3. **Brute-Force Counter**: If wrong code entered, increments `attempts = attempts + 1`. If `attempts >= 5`, permanently locks and consumes the code.
4. **Timing-Safe Comparison**: Byte-level constant-time `MessageDigest.isEqual` protects against side-channel attacks.
5. **Atomicity**: Sets `is_verified = TRUE` and `is_consumed = TRUE` in PostgreSQL.

---

### 🔀 Smart Gateway Responses:
- **First-Time Signups (`isNewUser: true`)**:
  - Issues a scoped `onboardingToken` for profile setup.
  - Returns ₹100 Welcome Bonus preview (`WELCOME100`).
  - Routes to `nextScreen: "PROFILE_SETUP_SCREEN_08"`.

- **Returning Members (`isNewUser: false`)**:
  - Issues customer Bearer JWT `token` and `refreshToken`.
  - Creates a registered session in `user_sessions`.
  - Routes to `nextScreen: "HOME_DASHBOARD"`.

response.name: 200 OK — First-Time Signup (Routes to Profile Setup)
200 OK — Returning Member (Routes to Home Dashboard)
401 Unauthorized — Invalid OTP Code
401 Unauthorized — OTP Expired (> 5 mins)
401 Unauthorized — Max 5 Attempts Exceeded (Lockout)

request.description:
### Compulsory Customer Profile Setup (Screen 08)

Finalizes a newly registered customer's account profile using their scoped `onboardingToken`.

---

### 📥 Request Body Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fullName` | `string` | **Yes** | Customer's full name. | `"Rahul Sharma"` |
| `email` | `string` | No | Customer's email address. | `"rahul.sharma@example.com"` |
| `city` | `string` | **Yes** | Primary operational city (from `/api/v1/discovery/cities`). | `"Ahmedabad"` |
| `state` | `string` | No | State of residence (from `/api/v1/discovery/states`). | `"Gujarat"` |
| `district` | `string` | No | District of residence. | `"Ahmedabad"` |
| `pincode` | `string` | No | Postal PIN code. | `"380015"` |
| `gender` | `string` | No | Gender (`MALE`, `FEMALE`, `OTHER`). | `"MALE"` |
| `address` | `string` | No | Street address / residential location. | `"101, Galaxy Heights, S.G. Highway"` |
| `birthday` | `string` | No | Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`) for birthday rewards. | `"1998-05-15"` |
| `referralCode` | `string` | No | Referral code of the friend who invited them. | `"FRIEND100"` |
| `categoryPreferences` | `array` | No | Active categories from `/api/v1/discovery/categories` (supports UUIDs, slugs, or names). | `["11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111101"]` |

---

### 🎁 Post-Setup Operations
1. Updates `users` table: sets `profile_completed = TRUE`, `full_name`, `email`, `primary_city`, `state`, `district`, `pincode`, `address`, `gender`, `birthday`.
2. Generates user's permanent referral code (e.g. `PINAK8899`).
3. Credits the ₹100 welcome reward coupon (`WELCOME100`) to the customer's wallet.
4. Upgrades auth level: invalidates `onboardingToken` and issues permanent customer JWT `token` + `refreshToken`.
